title: Apollo, Silver Point Lead $900 Million Private Loan to Vantage
content: Apollo Global Management Inc. and Silver Point Capital led a roughly $900 million direct loan to Vantage Specialty Chemicals to replace the company’s existing bank-arranged financing, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

title: WisdomTree Puts Private-Credit Exposure on the Blockchain
content: WisdomTree Inc. launched its first tokenized fund that gives investors exposure to private credit, marking the latest attempt by Wall Street to connect fast-growing markets with blockchain technology.

title: France’s Debt Woes Mount as Fitch Downgrades Credit Rating
content: Fitch Ratings downgraded France, indicating the upheaval of repeated government collapse has locked the country into an enduring battle to contain a swelling debt burden.

title: Still Comfortable Moving Down in Credit Quality: Lynam
content: BlackRock's Head of Macro Credit Research Amanda Lynam says they are still comfortable selectively moving down in credit quality and that we're seeing winners and losers within the same reading category, within the same sector. She speaks with Scarlet Fu on 'Real Yield.' (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed’s Cook Declared Second House as Vacation Home, Reuters Says
content: A 2021 loan document reviewed by Reuters shows Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook declared an Atlanta home she purchased as a “vacation home,” appearing to contradict the Trump administration’s claims that she committed mortgage fraud.

title: New Fortress Energy Advisers Prepare for Confidential Debt Talks
content: Advisers to various groups of New Fortress Energy Inc. creditors have signed non-disclosure agreements with the liquefied natural gas company as it begins restructuring talks after prolonged project delays have left it struggling to cover debt costs, according to people familiar with the situation.

title: Djamo Gets Green Light to Offer Loans and Savings in Ivory Coast
content: Djamo Finances has secured a microfinance license from the Central Bank of West African States, allowing the Ivorian fintech to operate as a microfinance institution in Ivory Coast.

title: Vietnam Warns of Major Data Theft After Credit Center Hacked
content: Vietnam said a cyberattack on the National Credit Information Center could have led to a major breach of personal data and warned the public to be on alert as it investigates the scale of the threat.

title: Spain Scores Credit-Rating Upgrade From S&P Global Ratings
content: Spain’s credit rating was raised one notch by S&P Global Ratings, which cited an improvement in the external balance sheet alongside a decade of private sector deleveraging.

title: IMF Sees Africa Needing More Credit After Loans Top $69 Billion
content: Demand from African nations for financing from the International Monetary Fund is expected to remain high, as debt burdens mount and cheaper options remain scarce, even as backlash grows over its austerity-heavy terms.

title: Ram Cancels All-Electric Pickup for US Amid Slowing Demand
content: Stellantis NV, which owns the Jeep and Ram brands, has canceled plans to bring its all-electric pickup truck to market, the latest product shakeup after competitors’ models failed to meet expectations and Congress moved to eliminate tax credits for EV buyers.
